findings.finding: Tail coverage counts high-amplitude frames, not unique sample identities or ordering. The exact 12000 count catches uncompensated truncation but cannot prove every original tail sample arrived if loss is exactly compensated by duplicate high-amplitude tail data.
findings.recommendation: Treat this as end-marker count and endpoint characterization, not sample-identity/gapless proof. No broad new test matrix is required for this scoped PR.
